metadata.method_name: TP-G2: factorial discipline x container frame and survivor placement (iteration 10)
metadata.description: Name-scrubbed grid path programs written by Qwen3-32B in a pre-committed 6x6 discipline x container factorial (24 implementable cells, 12 verified programs each), teacher-forced under iteration 9's neutral-twin context; program-state RDMs (Qwen3-8B bf16 block 17, Qwen3-32B NF4 block 33, R1) tested for discipline vs container with partial Spearman, restricted permutations and program bootstrap (G1); survivor families of the five-name ban and covert BFS/DFS placed on the factorial + catalogue frame with iteration 9's geodesic landing code (G2).

deviations.text: Commit #1 split into #1a (cells, prompts, verifiers, all G1/G2 rules and predictions, before wave A), #1b (placed-program family lists with uids and code sha256, before any placed-program state) and #1c (sha256 of g1.py / g2.py / figures.py, before any G1/G2 output on real data and before the factorial freeze is analysed).
F-COV has 136 programs (five-name ban, 9 non-C6 configurations) instead of ~294; the 98 covert programs of the iteration-2 single/multi-name bans are placed as F-COVX (descriptive).

Ran on an RTX 2000 Ada 16 GB with 6 CPUs and 28 GB RAM (plan: RTX A4500). Qwen3-8B keeps 27 blocks (extraction blocks 9-25 odd + 26), Qwen3-32B NF4 keeps 40 blocks (21, 25, 29, 31, 33, 35, 37, 39); primary blocks 17 / 33 unchanged.
HF_HOME was not overridden (run rule: the shared cache is pre-set); the plan's HF_HOME=./hf_cache was not used, so no hf_cache/ exists in the workspace.

exp46 frozen state caches (cache/states/mcode_8b.npz, mcode_32b.npz, geo_*_k15/k10.npz; 0.6 GB) and the dependency's full_data_out.json (96 MB) are read in place; their sha256 is in inputs_manifest.json (in_place). Everything else is copied into inputs/ or src/ / vendor/.

State reproduction of 10 cached iteration-9 programs: hook check exact (max abs diff 0) and n_code_tokens 10/10 equal, but min cosine 0.99981 (8B) / 0.99990 (32B) against the 0.9999 threshold (mean 0.99996 / 0.99998): iteration 9 ran on an RTX 5090, this round on an RTX 2000 Ada (bf16 kernel numerics). Catalogue states are still taken from the iteration-9 cache.

Amendment in COMMIT1a (before wave A): the tracer reads the planted scan-derived GRID2D programs of BFSO, HEUR and COST as OTHER / DFS, so GRID2D discipline checks use the AST signature + a hand read.

RELAX cells have no frontier; their container check is the structure swept every round (2-D arrays / explicit edge list / set of cells) inside a repeat loop, with no deque, heap, popleft, pop(0) or insort.
Thinking off via reasoning.enabled=false plus the Qwen3 '/no_think' suffix (DeepInfra ignores the flag alone; iteration-9 D10); smoke test confirmed 1 reasoning token.

Top-ups: bibfs 12 and iddfs 12 generated; biastar 6 generated + 6 paraphrases; jps 0 of ~100 generated attempts verified, so all 12 JPS programs are paraphrases of the S3 reference jps4.py (no 50% cap for S3-seeded top-ups). JPS placement and frame evidence is therefore reference-derived, low independence.
RELAX-SET reached 11 verified programs at freeze (one hand-read REJECT); above the 10 floor, N flagged.

Hand reads (139 rows in data/hand_reads_v10.jsonl): full programs for the first batches of every hand-read cell; later programs of highly uniform cells (GRID2D, BFSO-SET, IDDFS, BiBFS, BiA*) on their selection-rule / structure lines plus a container grep; JPS paraphrases 3 in full and 9 by jump-helper structure plus heap-push counts equal to the reference. Reasons are recorded per row.

Primary, crossed-core and cell-cluster bootstraps use 1,000 resamples and 2,000 restricted permutations as committed; the sensitivity variants (S3-S7, S10) use 200 program-bootstrap resamples and S2 semi-partial CIs 100, for time (the box was CPU-bound).
A first full G1 run was killed after BLAS oversubscription (load 14 on 6 CPUs) and rerun with one BLAS thread per process; results come from the rerun (same code, same seeds).

T7 synthetic 'discipline-only' states encode the committed D_disc geometry (COST half-way from BFSO) and use noise 0.6; with independent discipline means the tie structure of D_disc caps rho_dc below 0.5.
F-RF has 14 programs (iteration-8 randomized-DFS rows counted as random frontiers) and F-OTH 8 (plan: 13 and 10).
Frame catalogue = 129 iteration-9 M-code PRIMARY programs (frozen states, other GPU) + 48 frozen top-ups (this round); bibfs/iddfs/biastar classes mix both sources.

results/positioning.json is a title-level screen of 6 dated OpenAlex scholarly queries (top results, verdicts occupies/adjacent/irrelevant); verbatim quotes were not fetched (time), so verdicts are provisional.

src/g1.py differs from its COMMIT1c hash only by two lines in synthetic_states (the T7 test generator places COST half-way from BFSO); removing them reproduces the committed sha256 exactly (checked). All statistics functions are as committed; g2.py, r0.py, extract.py, assemble.py, freeze.py and tests/test_analysis.py match their committed hashes.

src/analysis.py (G1/G2 drivers: frame assembly, sensitivity list, subframe filters) was written after COMMIT1c and before any G1/G2 output, implementing COMMIT1a's rules, but was not hash-committed. After a first quick G1 run (whose numbers equal the final ones) only worker counts, BLAS threads and sensitivity bootstrap counts changed. src/figures.py and src/outputs.py were written after the G1/G2 outputs (presentation only), so the planned COMMIT1d did not happen.

examples.output:
from collections import deque

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0]) if rows > 0 else 0
    if not (0 <= start[0] < rows and 0 <= start[1] < cols) or not (0 <= goal[0] < rows and 0 <= goal[1] < cols) or grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or (grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#'):
        return []
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    frontier = deque()
    parent = {}
    seen = set()
    directions = [(0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1), (-1, 0)]
    frontier.append(start)
    seen.add(start)
    while frontier:
        current = frontier.popleft()
        if current == goal:
            path = []
            while current in parent:
                path.append(current)
                current = parent[current]
            path.append(start)
            return path[::-1]
        r, c = current
        for dr, dc in directions:
            nr, nc = (r + dr, c + dc)
            if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols and (grid[nr][nc] == '.') and ((nr, nc) not in seen):
                frontier.append((nr, nc))
                seen.add((nr, nc))
                parent[nr, nc] = current
    return []

from collections import deque

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    if not (0 <= start[0] < len(grid) and 0 <= start[1] < len(grid[0])) or grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or (not (0 <= goal[0] < len(grid) and 0 <= goal[1] < len(grid[0]))) or (grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#'):
        return []
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    rows, cols = (len(grid), len(grid[0]))
    directions = [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]
    seen = set()
    parent = {}
    q = deque()
    q.append(start)
    seen.add(start)
    while q:
        current = q.popleft()
        for dr, dc in directions:
            next_cell = (current[0] + dr, current[1] + dc)
            row, col = next_cell
            if 0 <= row < rows and 0 <= col < cols and (grid[row][col] == '.') and (next_cell not in seen):
                if next_cell == goal:
                    parent[next_cell] = current
                    path = []
                    step = next_cell
                    while step != start:
                        path.append(step)
                        step = parent[step]
                    path.append(start)
                    return path[::-1]
                seen.add(next_cell)
                parent[next_cell] = current
                q.append(next_cell)
    return []

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    from collections import deque
    if not (0 <= start[0] < len(grid) and 0 <= start[1] < len(grid[0])):
        return []
    if not (0 <= goal[0] < len(grid) and 0 <= goal[1] < len(grid[0])):
        return []
    if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#':
        return []
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    rows, cols = (len(grid), len(grid[0]))
    seen = [[False for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]
    parent = [[None for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]
    frontier = []
    frontier.append(start)
    seen[start[0]][start[1]] = True
    parent[start[0]][start[1]] = start
    directions = [(0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1), (-1, 0)]
    while frontier:
        cell = frontier.pop(0)
        if cell == goal:
            break
        for dr, dc in directions:
            nr, nc = (cell[0] + dr, cell[1] + dc)
            if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols and (grid[nr][nc] == '.') and (not seen[nr][nc]):
                seen[nr][nc] = True
                parent[nr][nc] = cell
                frontier.append((nr, nc))
    if parent[goal[0]][goal[1]] is None:
        return []
    path = []
    curr = goal
    while curr != start:
        path.append(curr)
        curr = parent[curr[0]][curr[1]]
    path.append(start)
    path.reverse()
    return path

import heapq

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    if not (0 <= start[0] < len(grid) and 0 <= start[1] < len(grid[0])) or not (0 <= goal[0] < len(grid) and 0 <= goal[1] < len(grid[0])):
        return []
    if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#':
        return []
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    seen = set()
    parent = {}
    counter = 0
    heap = []
    heapq.heappush(heap, (counter, start[0], start[1]))
    seen.add(start)
    counter += 1
    directions = [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]
    while heap:
        _, row, col = heapq.heappop(heap)
        for dr, dc in directions:
            new_row, new_col = (row + dr, col + dc)
            if 0 <= new_row < len(grid) and 0 <= new_col < len(grid[0]) and (grid[new_row][new_col] == '.') and ((new_row, new_col) not in seen):
                seen.add((new_row, new_col))
                parent[new_row, new_col] = (row, col)
                heapq.heappush(heap, (counter, new_row, new_col))
                counter += 1
                if (new_row, new_col) == goal:
                    path = []
                    curr = goal
                    while curr != start:
                        path.append(curr)
                        curr = parent[curr]
                    path.append(start)
                    return path[::-1]
    return []

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    if start == goal:
        row, col = start
        if 0 <= row < len(grid) and 0 <= col < len(grid[0]) and (grid[row][col] == '.'):
            return [start]
        return []
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0]) if rows > 0 else 0
    if not (0 <= start[0] < rows and 0 <= start[1] < cols and (grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '.')):

    if not (0 <= goal[0] < rows and 0 <= goal[1] < cols and (grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '.')):
        return []
    visited = [[False for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]
    parent = [[None for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]
    frontier = deque()
    frontier.append(start)
    visited[start[0]][start[1]] = True
    directions = [(0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1), (-1, 0)]
    while frontier:

        if current == goal:
            break
        for dr, dc in directions:
            r, c = (current[0] + dr, current[1] + dc)
            if 0 <= r < rows and 0 <= c < cols and (grid[r][c] == '.') and (not visited[r][c]):

                visited[r][c] = True
                parent[r][c] = current

        return []
    path = []

        path.append(current)
        current = parent[current[0]][current[1]]

import heapq

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    if not 0 <= start[0] < len(grid) or not 0 <= start[1] < len(grid[0]) or (not 0 <= goal[0] < len(grid)) or (not 0 <= goal[1] < len(grid[0])):
        return []
    if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#':
        return []
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    visited = set()
    parent = {}
    directions = [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]
    counter = 0
    heap = []
    heapq.heappush(heap, (-counter, start[0], start[1]))
    visited.add(start)
    counter += 1
    while heap:
        key, row, col = heapq.heappop(heap)
        current = (row, col)
        if current == goal:
            path = []
            while current != start:
                path.append(current)
                current = parent[current]
            path.append(start)
            return path[::-1]
        for dr, dc in directions:
            nr, nc = (row + dr, col + dc)
            neighbor = (nr, nc)
            if 0 <= nr < len(grid) and 0 <= nc < len(grid[0]) and (grid[nr][nc] == '.') and (neighbor not in visited):
                visited.add(neighbor)
                parent[neighbor] = current
                heapq.heappush(heap, (-counter, nr, nc))
                counter += 1
    return []

    rows, cols = (len(grid), len(grid[0]))

    dist = [[float('inf')] * cols for _ in range(rows)]

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    if start == goal:
        return [start] if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '.' else []
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0]) if rows > 0 else 0
    if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#' or (not (0 <= start[0] < rows and 0 <= start[1] < cols)) or (not (0 <= goal[0] < rows and 0 <= goal[1] < cols)):
        return []
    directions = [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]
    frontier = []
    seen = dict()
    parent = dict()
    key = abs(start[0] - goal[0]) + abs(start[1] - goal[1])
    frontier.append((key, 0, start[0], start[1]))
    seen[start[0], start[1]] = True
    counter = 1
    while frontier:
        min_index = 0
        for i in range(1, len(frontier)):
            if frontier[i] < frontier[min_index]:
                min_index = i
        key, _, row, col = frontier.pop(min_index)
        if (row, col) == goal:
            path = []
            current = (row, col)
            while current:
                path.append(current)
                current = parent.get(current)
            return path[::-1]
        for dr, dc in directions:
            new_row, new_col = (row + dr, col + dc)
            if 0 <= new_row < rows and 0 <= new_col < cols and (grid[new_row][new_col] == '.') and ((new_row, new_col) not in seen):
                new_key = abs(new_row - goal[0]) + abs(new_col - goal[1])
                frontier.append((new_key, counter, new_row, new_col))
                seen[new_row, new_col] = True
                parent[new_row, new_col] = (row, col)
                counter += 1
    return []

import random

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#':
        return []
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    rows, cols = (len(grid), len(grid[0]))
    seen = [[False for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]
    parent = [[None for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]
    frontier = [start]
    seen[start[0]][start[1]] = True
    while frontier:
        cell = frontier.pop(random.randrange(len(frontier)))
        r, c = cell
        for dr, dc in [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]:
            nr, nc = (r + dr, c + dc)
            if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols and (not seen[nr][nc]) and (grid[nr][nc] == '.'):
                seen[nr][nc] = True
                parent[nr][nc] = cell
                frontier.append((nr, nc))
                if (nr, nc) == goal:
                    path = []
                    current = goal
                    while current:
                        path.append(current)
                        current = parent[current[0]][current[1]]
                    return path[::-1]
    return []

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    if not (0 <= start[0] < len(grid) and 0 <= start[1] < len(grid[0]) and (grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '.')):

                parent[nr][nc] = (cr, cc)

import heapq
import random

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#':
        return []
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    directions = [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]
    seen = set()
    frontier = []
    parent = {}
    heapq.heappush(frontier, (random.random(), start[0], start[1]))
    seen.add((start[0], start[1]))
    while frontier:
        _, r, c = heapq.heappop(frontier)
        if (r, c) == goal:
            path = []
            while (r, c) != start:
                path.append((r, c))
                r, c = parent[r, c]
            path.append(start)
            path.reverse()
            return path
        for dr, dc in directions:
            nr, nc = (r + dr, c + dc)
            if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols and (grid[nr][nc] == '.') and ((nr, nc) not in seen):
                seen.add((nr, nc))
                parent[nr, nc] = (r, c)
                heapq.heappush(frontier, (random.random(), nr, nc))
    return []

from collections import deque

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    if start == goal:
        return [start] if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '.' else []
    if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#':
        return []
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0]) if rows > 0 else 0
    visited = set()
    prev = {}
    q = deque()
    visited.add(start)
    q.append(start)
    found = False
    while q:
        current = q.popleft()
        current_row, current_col = current
        if current == goal:
            found = True
            break
        first = True
        for dr, dc in [(-1, 0), (0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1)]:
            nr = current_row + dr
            nc = current_col + dc
            next_node = (nr, nc)
            if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols:
                if grid[nr][nc] == '.' and next_node not in visited:
                    visited.add(next_node)
                    prev[next_node] = current
                    if first:
                        q.appendleft(next_node)
                    else:
                        q.append(next_node)
                    first = False
    if not found:
        return []
    path = []
    current = goal
    while current != start:
        path.append(current)
        current = prev[current]
    path.append(start)
    path.reverse()
    return path

import heapq

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    rows = len(grid)
    if rows == 0:
        return []
    cols = len(grid[0])
    start_row, start_col = start
    goal_row, goal_col = goal
    if start_row < 0 or start_row >= rows or start_col < 0 or (start_col >= cols) or (grid[start_row][start_col] == '#'):
        return []
    if goal_row < 0 or goal_row >= rows or goal_col < 0 or (goal_col >= cols) or (grid[goal_row][goal_col] == '#'):
        return []
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    directions = [(-1, 0), (0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1)]
    heap = []
    heapq.heappush(heap, (0, start_row, start_col))
    visited = [[False for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]
    visited[start_row][start_col] = True
    prev = [[None for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]
    found = False
    while heap:
        dist, r, c = heapq.heappop(heap)
        if (r, c) == goal:
            found = True
            break
        for dr, dc in directions:
            nr = r + dr
            nc = c + dc
            if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols:
                if not visited[nr][nc] and grid[nr][nc] == '.':
                    visited[nr][nc] = True
                    prev[nr][nc] = (r, c)
                    heapq.heappush(heap, (dist + 1, nr, nc))
    if not found:
        return []
    path = []
    current = goal
    while current is not None:
        path.append(current)
        current = prev[current[0]][current[1]]
    path.reverse()
    return path

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#':
        return []
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0]) if rows > 0 else 0
    directions = [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]
    import heapq
    visited = set()
    predecessors = {}
    pq = []
    heapq.heappush(pq, (start[0], start[1]))
    visited.add((start[0], start[1]))
    found = False
    while pq:
        r, c = heapq.heappop(pq)
        if (r, c) == goal:
            found = True
            break
        for dr, dc in directions:
            nr = r + dr
            nc = c + dc
            if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols:
                if grid[nr][nc] == '.' and (nr, nc) not in visited:
                    visited.add((nr, nc))
                    predecessors[nr, nc] = (r, c)
                    heapq.heappush(pq, (nr, nc))
    if not found:
        return []
    path = []
    current = goal
    while current != start:
        path.append(current)
        current = predecessors[current]
    path.append(start)
    path.reverse()
    return path

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    rows = len(grid)
    if rows == 0:
        return []
    cols = len(grid[0])
    start_row, start_col = start
    goal_row, goal_col = goal
    if start_row < 0 or start_row >= rows or start_col < 0 or (start_col >= cols) or (grid[start_row][start_col] == '#') or (grid[goal_row][goal_col] == '#'):
        return []
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    visited = [[False for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]
    parent = [[None for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]
    queue = [(start_row, start_col)]
    visited[start_row][start_col] = True
    directions = [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]
    while queue:
        r, c = queue.pop(0)
        for dr, dc in directions:
            nr, nc = (r + dr, c + dc)
            if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols and (not visited[nr][nc]) and (grid[nr][nc] == '.'):
                visited[nr][nc] = True
                parent[nr][nc] = (r, c)
                queue.append((nr, nc))
                if (nr, nc) == goal:
                    break
    path = []
    current = goal
    while current is not None:
        path.append(current)
        current = parent[current[0]][current[1]]
    path.reverse()
    return path if path[0] == start else []
